title: Seacrest Beach "A in the Sand" 65 A Street
h1: Seacrest Beach "A in the Sand" 65 A Street
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Private pool *Pool heating is available from October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $45 per day.- Short walk to the deeded beach access- Third floor lookout area with Gulf Views- Short Walking/Biking Distance to Alys and Rosemary Beach- Easy access to 30A and bike path- 6-passenger Low Speed Vehicle- 7 adult bikes- 5 parking spots- In-home fitness center- In-home elevator- Sauna- Peloton *An exclusive Alaya amenity- Media room- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Refresh in luxury at 65 A Street, a stunning 6-bedroom, 8.5-bathroom Main and Carriage Home that accommodates 24 guests, offering plenty of room for large groups and multi-generational families. Savor relaxing days in the private pool, movie nights in the media room, Gulf sunsets from the lookout tower, and daily walks to the pristine beach—only 1-minute away. Tucked between Alys and Seacrest Beach, this property is a perfect base for experiencing 30A’s beauty and attractions! Simple luxury meets aesthetic drama inside this 2-level Main Home. In the living space, discover pillow-soft seating beneath an exquisite wood ceiling and an expressive sea life art piece. On the room’s opposite end, a gourmet kitchen with a top-of-the-line Wolf stove and an expansive center island welcomes homemade or catered meals. Between the two is a sophisticated dining table for 8, with additional seating for 6 at the breakfast bar. French doors open onto the courtyard, marrying the indoor and outdoor spaces. Step outside to unwind on the pool’s sun shelf, or sink into the sitting spa for a nighttime soak! Beneath the angled pergola, an outdoor living space and a neighboring grill area encourage hours of fun. A full gym with a Peloton bike and sauna, and a laundry room add convenience throughout every stay. When it’s time to retire, find a comfy king bed and a private bathroom in the guest bedroom. Entertainment awaits on the second level, beginning with a game table, arcade machine, wet bar, and shuffleboard table. A spacious media room offers epic comfort while streaming movies. Guests can choose between 3 guest bedrooms with private bathrooms, featuring 1 king bed, 1 king bed and a sleeper sofa, and 2 queen beds, respectively. There’s also a bunk room with 2 queen-over-queen bunk beds and 1 twin-over-twin bunk bed.On the top floor, greet the day with Gulf views at sunrise and a delicious cup of coffee. The private Carriage Home features a kitchen, a living space with a queen sleeper sofa, and a guest bedroom with a king bed.Experience a luxury Seacrest Beach vacation at 65 A Street. Parking for 5 vehicles—plus a 6-passenger low-speed vehicle and 8 complimentary adult bikes—makes exploring easy. For deeded beach access, head west on 30A and take the small trail between homes 8870 and 8858. Book today! SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 24):FIRST FLOOR:-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate-Additional Living Area: Full Gym with Sauna with a Private Half Bathroom, and Additional Half Bath in HallwaySECOND FLOOR:-Guest Bedroom: King Bed and Sleeper Sofa, Private Bathroom with Shower Only-Guest Bedroom: 2 Queen Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower Only-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only-Guest Bedroom: 2 Queen-over-Queen Bunks Beds and Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed , Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo-Additional Living Area: Media RoomCARRIAGE HOUSE:-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo-Additional Sleeping Area: Queen Sleeper Sofa-Half Bathroom on the bottom floor*The location of this home is advertised in Seacrest Beach with close proximity to Alys Beach. The official address is in Alys Beach, but many of the amenities are within Seacrest Beach.*Garage is not for guest use.*RV parking is not permitted at this property.
